_comment: Single source of truth for what the built userscript bundle must and must not
contain. Both .github/workflows/build-apk.yml and .github/workflows/ci.yml call
tools/check_bundle_contract.py, and TizenTube/mods/tests/read the retiredActions
list, so a feature can never be asserted in one place and retired in another.
Why this file exists: the 2.9 release build failed because the workflow carried
its own copy of this list and still required YTARK_YTS_EDITOR after the 2.9
settings work deliberately retired that command. The stale assertion stopped
every run in the userscript step, before the repack, sign and upload steps,
so no 2.9 APK was ever produced. Update this file, not the workflows.
Every entry is checked against the artefact that is actually shipped:
bundle.required    - literal text that must appear in dist/userScript.js
bundle.forbidden   - literal text that must not appear in dist/userScript.js
retiredActions     - command names that must be absent from the bundle and the
shipped sources, and that the userscript tests must reject
files.forbidden    - source files that must no longer exist
sources.forbidden  - literal text that must not appear in the shipped sources
markup.forbidden   - regular expression that must not match the bundle
branding.required  - literal text that must appear in the bundle
branding.forbidden - regular expression that must not match the bundle

Retired command names must appear nowhere in the shipped artefact, and the bundled changelog is part of that artefact, so the changelog narrative describes a retirement without repeating the retired identifier (the same rule the 2.5 removals follow for quickControls, RESET_USER_AGENT_PROFILE and DEVICE_PROFILES).

required: Newer than the latest stable release

branding._patternNote: Python regular expressions (this contract is enforced by tools/check_bundle_contract.py), equivalent to the retired shell grep -Eqi 'Personal[[:space:]]+Tube[[:space:]]+TV'.
